newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government will require an additional 20 billion taka a year to implement recommendations of a Pay Commission report to be submitted to the government next week.
Jatiya Party chief Hussain Mohammad Ershad on Wednesday expelled former Prime Minister Kazi Zafar Ahmed and former Deputy Prime Minister Shah Moazzem Hussain.
In a bid to strengthen the privatisation process, the government has decided to include MPs, business personalities, professionals and labour leaders in the Privatisation Board.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday said her government was committed to help flourish and protect the local industries.
Opposition leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Wednesday expressed concern that an agreement giving a trade corridor to India might have been signed.
The government is planning to set up new fertiliser factories and other gas-based industries, Commerce and Industries Minister said on Wednesday.
Paragon Leather and Footwear Industries Ltd has received export orders worth $22.86 million.
World Bank President James Wolfensohn will visit Bangladesh in October. REUTER
